statement.excerpt: The collapse of the largest company in the ecosystem would also seize up any and all AI data center debt (if any exists at that point), because the literal largest consumer of AI compute would be dead.

from_speaker: The collapse of the largest company in the ecosystem
seize up any and all AI data center debt
if any exists at that point
our_interpretation: The company is OpenAI. Collapse means business failure ending its ordinary independent operations, potentially through a distressed absorption into another company.
The plain reading of 'seize up' is a market-wide halt to new AI data center lending and debt issuance, rather than merely higher interest rates or falling bond prices.
The forecast applies only after OpenAI collapses and only if an AI data center debt market then exists.
No deadline or duration of the predicted freeze is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: After a documented OpenAI collapse, comprehensive issuance and lending records establish a market-wide halt attributable to that collapse, with an AI data center debt market existing immediately beforehand.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After a documented OpenAI collapse, completed new AI data center lending or debt issuance establishes that the claimed universal freeze did not occur.
